items.title: 61428_Red Callender oral history interview
items.q: My first film that I remember being in was when I first got here, in I think 1937, a thing called Think Fast, Mr. Moto, with Peter Lorre.

ctx.x: Oh, no. My first film that I remember being in was when I first got here, in I think 1937, a thing called Think Fast, Mr. Moto, with Peter Lorre. I was just a sideline musician, but I was in it anyhow. That one wasn't listed, because they didn't call that "Jazz" in those days. See, "Jazz" has been a dirty name for pictures.
